metadata.title: Oksusu Cha | Corn Tea | Korean recipe
metadata.description:
This is one of the first video of my new segment "Brew" on my channel Eat Your Kappa. In this video I show you how to make Korean Corn Tea, also known as Oksusu cha with Corn kernels.

The flavour is delicate and is nutty in taste, this is quite a popular drink.

Ingredients required

Dry corn kernels
Water

Lets Connect!

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eatyourkappa/
email: eatyourkappa@gmail.com
